description: A single 150-unit exact-input swap on pool B collects a 1-unit hook fee (1% of gross output, rounded down). Creator intent R1 credits floor(1/2) = 0 rebate, and the EVM agrees, but the draft base specification imposes a minimum_rebate of 1 and predicts 1 earned unit. This mirrors the pool-A rounding falsification on pool B (0.05% LP fee), showing the draft spec defect is not pool-specific, without any contract violation.
